lerobot_train_help_head:
usage: lerobot-train [-h] [--config_path str] [--dataset str]
                     [--dataset.repo_id str] [--dataset.root [str]]
                     [--dataset.episodes [List]] [--image_transforms str]
                     [--dataset.image_transforms.enable bool]
                     [--dataset.image_transforms.max_num_transforms int]

                     [--dataset.image_transforms.tfs Dict]

                     [--dataset.video_backend str] [--dataset.streaming bool]

                     [--env.visualization_height int] [--robot str]
                     [--env.robot.type {}] [--teleop str]

                     [--env.processor.control_mode str] [--observation str]

                     [--env.embodiment [str]] [--env.object [str]]

                     [--env.seed [int]] [--env.device [str]]
                     [--env.disable_fabric bool] [--env.enable_cameras bool]
                     [--env.headless bool] [--env.enable_pinocchio bool]
                     [--env.environment [str]] [--env.state_dim int]
